restaurantName: Bai Jia Chun Hao De Lai Jiang Mu Ya (Zhongxing Road)
address: 40-102 Zhongxing Road, Siming, Xiamen, China Mainland
bio: Ever since this neighbourhood joint opened its doors in 1996, there have only been four items on the menu – ginger duck stew, duck gizzards, blanched leafy greens and steamed rice. In the most famous restaurant for ginger duck in the whole of Xiamen, rows and rows of claypots containing local Muscovy duck and old ginger sizzle in rice wine and sesame oil, exuding addictive aromas. The duck gizzards tend to run out, so come early....
pageTitle: Bai Jia Chun Hao De Lai Jiang Mu Ya (Zhongxing Road)
